title: BLFHumanReviewDecision
description: Schema for recording native-speaker and linguist judgments on candidate linguistic review items.

review_id.description: Unique identifier for this review decision record.

item_id.description: ID of the reviewed candidate item.

reviewer_id_pseudonymous.description: Pseudonymous identifier for the human evaluator (e.g. REV-LINGUIST-01).

native_variety.description: Native dialect/regional background of the reviewer.

region.description: Geographic division or district of origin in Bangladesh.

review_timestamp.description: ISO UTC timestamp of judgment completion.

judgment.description: Categorical acceptability judgment by human expert.

preferred_form.description: The candidate option preferred by the reviewer (e.g. 'A', 'B', or 'NONE').

correction.description: Suggested natural/grammatical correction in standard orthography if candidate is flawed.

comments.description: Linguistic notes, register nuances, or dialectal context.

adjudication_status.description: Pipeline reconciliation status across independent reviews.
